response.sql: WITH linked_data AS (SELECT tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist, sf.instownpct FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg), units AS (SELECT transreg, ordertypedist, AVG(instownpct) AS unit_ownership FROM linked_data WHERE ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY transreg, ordertypedist), mix_baselines AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(unit_ownership) AS mix_baseline FROM units GROUP BY ordertypedist), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(unit_ownership) AS overall_avg FROM units), kept_units AS (SELECT u.unit_ownership, mb.mix_baseline, oa.overall_avg FROM units u JOIN mix_baselines mb ON u.ordertypedist = mb.ordertypedist CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE u.unit_ownership > oa.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(unit_ownership) AS avg_ownership_kept_units, AVG(unit_ownership / mix_baseline) AS avg_ratio_to_mix_baseline, AVG(unit_ownership - overall_avg) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM kept_units;
